16 STUDENTS. NEW POSSIBILITIES. ✈️🔧

Some aviation dreams lead to the cockpit. Others begin with the tools that keep airplanes flying.

Epic Flight Academy has awarded $135,000 in scholarships to 16 high school students for pilot and aircraft mechanic training. The recipients will begin training in 2027.

There’s a Texas connection, too: Brayden Hayes of Arlington received a $5,000 pilot scholarship for training at Epic’s Addison location.

The awards also include aircraft mechanic scholarships for Jayanne Fejeran and Kole Legrand, each receiving $20,000 toward that path into aviation.

Reported by General Aviation News on November 9 and confirmed in Epic’s November 3 announcement, these awards are a reminder that aviation’s future depends on both the people at the controls and the people caring for the aircraft.

Congratulations to all 16 recipients. Here’s to the learning, persistence and first milestones ahead! 💛

Source: Epic Flight Academy, November 3, 2026; General Aviation News, November 9, 2026.
